section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section provides the date and time of the completion of the Sefer Torah.
section.t: Friday, Erev Shabbat Kodesh, Parshat Bo,

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section states that this was the completion of a Sefer Torah for the reception of Moshiach Tzidkeinu.
section.t: – The completion of the writing of a Sefer Torah for the reception of Moshiach Tzidkeinu –

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section notes that the writing was initiated and stirred by the Rebbe, the Nasi of our generation.
section.t: – Which he stirred and began its writing – before the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Nasi of our generation –
